main_text.p: mus, triplex est: sin partem hanc de qua modò commemorauimus, nimirum capita Pãdectarũ aut Codicis, quae vulgò Leges appellãtur, simplex. Commodissimum autem fore arbitror, si de singulis eius partibus breuiter, quid cuiusque proprium esse videatur, explicemus. Naturā tria quidem docendi genera videntur esse: quorum primum Galenus in libro qui Ars parua inscribitur, σύνθεσιν: alterum ἀνάλυσιν, tertium διαίρεσιν appellat. nos constructionem, dissolutionem, & partitionem dicere non incommodè possumus. Dialecticam autem ratione hanc

page.notes: The running head is printed with a ligature or symbol in place of the letters "ON" in "CONSVLTVS"; I have read it as CON. The word "Pãdectarũ" has a ligature for "ct" that is hard to read at this scan resolution. The long s is printed as f in "fingulis", which I have read as singulis. "Naturā" carries a macron that is faint on the scan. The ornament in the right margin beside "autem" is not text and is left out.
